name: checkbox
summary: A box and what checking it means: checked, not checked, or mixed.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What checking it means, beside the box and its spoken name.

properties.name: hideLabel
properties.description: Hides the label's words; the box keeps it as its name.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Supporting words under the label, read after the name.

properties.name: error
properties.description: What is wrong; the box's edge turns destructive.

properties.name: required
properties.description: The box must be checked; the label gets a marker and the name says required.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Shows a dash and is spoken as mixed, as a select-all box with some items checked.

events.name: change
events.description: The box was checked or unchecked.

states.name: rest
states.description: An edge at 3:1; filled in the primary colour when checked or mixed.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The box scales to the press scale, never under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its label, with required when it is; its state checked, not checked or mixed; then its error and description.
accessibility.keyboard: One tab stop; Space toggles it.
accessibility.web: A role="checkbox" with aria-checked (true, false or mixed), named by its label, aria-describedby for the description and error.
accessibility.apple: One element with the toggle trait, named by its label (", required"), its value Checked, Not checked or Mixed, its hint the error then the description.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.CheckBox with the Toggle pattern (On, Off, Indeterminate), named by its label.

cases.person: An empty box beside "I agree to the terms" with a red marker.

agent.name: I agree to the terms, required

cases.person: A filled box with a dash beside "Whole basket".

deviations: readOnly, name and value for forms, and CheckboxGroup.
Drawn: iOS has no checkbox. No readOnly, form name or value, or group yet.
